# Tariboy

> The control plane for autonomous coding agents — desktop workflows, operations, architecture, and reference.

## Docs

- [Tariboy](https://alekzonder.github.io/tariboy): Define reusable images, run coding agents interactively, and grow into autonomous teams.
- [Ten-minute quickstart](https://alekzonder.github.io/tariboy/quickstart): Install Tariboy, connect a host, build an image, and run one agent interactively and on Autopilot.
- [Remote hosts](https://alekzonder.github.io/tariboy/remote-hosts): Connect, provision, update, and remove Linux hosts through system OpenSSH.
- [Autopilot](https://alekzonder.github.io/tariboy/autopilot): Run bounded, observable iterations on timers and durable message triggers.
- [Task workflows](https://alekzonder.github.io/tariboy/task-workflows): Bind a workflow image to a queue so its tasks move through statuses with one owner each, gated by check scripts and driven by watch scripts; queue secrets, run modes, commands, routes, and troubleshooting.
- [Workflow images](https://alekzonder.github.io/tariboy/workflow-images): Build, validate, store, and inspect versioned, immutable workflow images from a Workflowfile.yaml source directory.
- [Security and controls](https://alekzonder.github.io/tariboy/security-controls): Trust boundaries, credential handling, budgets, audit, and operator stop controls.
- [Support](https://alekzonder.github.io/tariboy/support): Diagnose alpha issues, export safe diagnostics, roll back, and uninstall.
- [Building, testing & development](https://alekzonder.github.io/tariboy/development): Canonical contributor guide for the Go control plane, React UI, Rust desktop host, documentation, and isolated end-to-end tests.
- [Native Tasks](https://alekzonder.github.io/tariboy/tasks): Queue-owned, infinitely nested work shared by customers and agents, with comments, dependencies, answer tracking, and realtime Desktop updates.

## Images

- [Images](https://alekzonder.github.io/tariboy/images): Build plugin, Agent Skill, and ordered prompt artifacts, inspect them, and assign them to agents.
- [Agent Skills in images](https://alekzonder.github.io/tariboy/images/agent-skills): Package validated Agent Skills in schema-v2 images and expose them through Claude Code, Codex, or OpenCode.

## Architecture

- [Daemon architecture](https://alekzonder.github.io/tariboy/architecture): How tariboyd owns durable state, agent execution, APIs, plugins, policy, and recovery.
- [Agents & the iteration loop](https://alekzonder.github.io/tariboy/architecture/iteration-loop): An agent runs a series of supervised iterations, driven by a timer or by messages, on top of a whoami / loop / channels core.
- [The channel bus & messaging](https://alekzonder.github.io/tariboy/architecture/messaging): Messages move over a store-backed fan-out bus — six tables, per-agent delivery queues, and durable ack with redelivery.
- [The shim](https://alekzonder.github.io/tariboy/architecture/shim): tariboy-shim runs a single harness iteration under a watchdog, so a runaway iteration can be killed without touching the daemon.
- [State model — the DB is the source of truth](https://alekzonder.github.io/tariboy/architecture/state-model): The SQLite DB is the single source of configuration; live state is computed, not stored, which is why test daemons must be isolated.
- [The AI proxy & the audit log](https://alekzonder.github.io/tariboy/architecture/ai-proxy): Every LLM call routes through the in-process AI proxy, which enforces budgets and writes a per-iteration audit transcript.
- [Desktop web UI](https://alekzonder.github.io/tariboy/architecture/web-ui): React and xterm.js provide the Desktop control surface while host-local daemons remain API and WebSocket services.

## Binaries & commands

- [Binaries & commands](https://alekzonder.github.io/tariboy/binaries): Core binaries and the Telegram plugin built by make build.
- [tariboy (operator CLI)](https://alekzonder.github.io/tariboy/binaries/operator-cli): The human/CI client that talks to the daemon over its socket, grouped by noun.
- [Agent capability scripts](https://alekzonder.github.io/tariboy/binaries/agent-tools): Run packaged skill-local scripts inside an agent for identity, status, loop control, context, messaging, schedules, and durable work.
- [The compose workflow](https://alekzonder.github.io/tariboy/binaries/compose): Bring up a whole set of images, groups, and agents declaratively from a tariboy-compose.yaml.
- [tariboy-store](https://alekzonder.github.io/tariboy/binaries/store): A standalone image registry server that stores agent-image blobs and serves a token-authenticated push/pull API.

## Plugins

- [Plugins](https://alekzonder.github.io/tariboy/plugins): Understand Tariboy's built-in capabilities and instructions and its separately installed external plugin processes.

### Built-in plugins

- [Built-in plugins](https://alekzonder.github.io/tariboy/plugins/built-in): Reference for daemon-owned capabilities and instruction plugins shipped with Tariboy.
- [whoami](https://alekzonder.github.io/tariboy/plugins/built-in/whoami): Inspect the authenticated agent identity, working directory, active iteration, and client/daemon versions.
- [loop](https://alekzonder.github.io/tariboy/plugins/built-in/loop): Complete an iteration and control the current agent's autonomous loop through identity-bound tools.
- [messages](https://alekzonder.github.io/tariboy/plugins/built-in/messages): Publish, receive, acknowledge, reply to, and subscribe to durable channel messages.
- [context](https://alekzonder.github.io/tariboy/plugins/built-in/context): Read and atomically replace the durable working memory carried between agent iterations.
- [status](https://alekzonder.github.io/tariboy/plugins/built-in/status): Publish an operator-visible progress message intended to stay on one line without completing the current iteration.
- [workdir](https://alekzonder.github.io/tariboy/plugins/built-in/workdir): Expose an agent's absolute managed workdir as an explicit schema-v2 prompt instruction.
- [schedule](https://alekzonder.github.io/tariboy/plugins/built-in/schedule): Create agent-owned one-shot or cron schedules that wake the agent or publish to a channel.
- [scripts](https://alekzonder.github.io/tariboy/plugins/built-in/scripts): Run asynchronous one-shot or fixed-interval local commands with durable per-run logs.
- [image-creator](https://alekzonder.github.io/tariboy/plugins/built-in/image-creator): Build a runnable Tariboy image from any source directory readable by the daemon.
- [goal](https://alekzonder.github.io/tariboy/plugins/built-in/goal): Receive or set the selected Native Task and AI usage attribution.
- [tasks](https://alekzonder.github.io/tariboy/plugins/built-in/tasks): Use Native Tasks through the globally installed ttasks client.

## Images & groups

- [Images & groups](https://alekzonder.github.io/tariboy/images-and-groups): Reproducible agent images, custom groups, and portable team transfers.

## Reference

- [Command reference](https://alekzonder.github.io/tariboy/reference/commands): The full command reference — operator commands and agent capability scripts.
- [Channel bus reference](https://alekzonder.github.io/tariboy/reference/channels): How messages move through channels, how agents receive them, how deliveries are acknowledged, and which agent settings affect message handling.
